verdict.rationale: LobeChat's privacy page says chat data is stored locally on the client by default, with optional cloud sync. Its self-hosting docs say self-hosting gives "complete control over your data," so where data lives and how long it stays depends on the user's deployment choice. There is no documented in-product retention policy or deletion control. Missing for 10: explicit retention-period settings, documented conversation/account deletion or data-purge controls, deletion guarantees for cloud-synced data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
